metadata.title: 80 साल के सरपंच की सीक्रेट रेसिपी | महाराष्ट्र का देसी मुर्गा और भाखरी | Desi Murga & Bhakri
metadata.description: Shyam Sunder travelled to the remote tribal belts of Nandurbar district in Maharashtra to explore the rich and lesser-known food traditions of Adivasi communities. During this journey, he met 80-year-old Gorji Kalu Gavit, a respected elder whose life is deeply rooted in forest wisdom and traditional food practices. Gavit shared a closely guarded recipe of deshi chicken, cooked with an age-old technique passed down through generations. According to him, this powerful dish is not just about taste—it builds strength, stamina, and vitality, giving “horsepower” to both men and women. The story is a celebration of Adivasi knowledge, where food is medicine, culture, and strength woven together.
